slides.etiqueta: Your coffee is stealing the energy you think it gives you

slides.texto:
Caffeine blocks adenosine, your brain's tiredness signal.
It doesn't give you energy: it hides the fatigue for a few hours.

Its half-life is around 5–6 hours.
A coffee at 5pm → at 11pm you still have about half of it in your system.

You fall asleep, but your deep sleep suffers.
Next day, more tired → more coffee. The vicious circle.

First coffee 60–90 min after waking up. Last one before 2pm. Max 2–3 a day.
That's how I use it: as a tool, not a crutch.

“Zero sugar” doesn't mean zero effect. A large can can pack 150–200 mg of caffeine: about two coffees.
Count them in your daily total.
